037/**
038 * Performs an RFC 7591 / OpenID Connect Dynamic Client Registration (SEP-837) round-trip against an authorization
039 * server's {@code registration_endpoint}, returning the issued credentials as a redaction-safe
040 * {@link McpClientRegistration} keyed by the AS {@code issuer} (the SEP-2352 binding key).
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * The registration declares an {@code application_type} (SEP-837 <b>MUST</b>) &mdash; {@link McpApplicationType#NATIVE}
044 * for CLI/desktop/loopback clients, {@link McpApplicationType#WEB} for remote browser apps &mdash; along with the
045 * caller-supplied redirect URIs (see {@link LoopbackRedirectUris}), grant/response types, scope, and
046 * {@code token_endpoint_auth_method} ({@code none} for a public/native client by default;
047 * {@link Builder#confidential(boolean)} switches to {@code client_secret_basic}).  A protected registration endpoint's
048 * RFC 7591 &sect;3 initial access token is attached when {@link Builder#initialAccessToken(String)} is set.
049 *
050 * <p>
051 * The DCR-issued {@code client_id}/secret then feed F1's existing flows unchanged &mdash; DCR changes only how the
052 * {@code client_id} was obtained, not the {@code resource=} (RFC 8707) or {@code iss} (RFC 9207 / SEP-2468)
053 * enforcement; see {@link McpClientRegistrations} for the bridge to {@link McpAuthorizationCodeAcquirer} /
054 * {@link McpTokenProvider}.
055 *
056 * <p>
057 * {@link #register()} is the single public round-trip entry point.  Internally it is split into a request-build step and
058 * a response-parse step (both package-private, so the module's own tests can drive them without a network) &mdash; those
059 * helpers deliberately traffic in Nimbus {@code provided}-scope types and are <b>not</b> part of the public API.  A
060 * registration failure (e.g. {@code invalid_redirect_uri}) surfaces as an {@link McpAuthException} carrying the AS error
061 * code (SEP-837 "clients MUST be prepared to handle registration failures").
062 *
063 * <h5 class='topic'>Security</h5>
064 * <p>
065 * The registration endpoint MUST originate from validated AS metadata ({@link org.apache.juneau.rest.auth.oauth.oidc.OidcDiscoveryClient}
066 * enforces the RFC 8414 / OIDC issuer-identity check) and MUST be {@code https} (loopback exempt for local testing,
067 * matching {@code McpProtectedResourceMetadataClient.requireSecure}).  Client secrets are never logged &mdash;
068 * {@link #toString()} discloses only non-secret configuration and {@link McpClientRegistration} redacts its
069 * secret-bearing fields.
070 *
071 * @since 10.0.0
072 */
073@SuppressWarnings({
074   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., ARG_value)
075})
076public class McpDynamicClientRegistrar {
077
078   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
079   private static final String ARG_value = "value";
080   private static final String ARG_values = "values";
081
082   /**
083    * Static creator.
084    *
085    * @return A new builder.
086    */
087   public static Builder create() {

091   /**
092    * Builder.
093    */
094   public static class Builder {
095      URI registrationEndpoint;
096      URI issuer;
097      McpApplicationType applicationType;
098      final List<URI> redirectUris = new ArrayList<>();
099      final Set<String> scopes = st();
100      final Set<String> grantTypes = st();
101      final Set<String> responseTypes = st();
102      boolean confidential;
103      String clientName;
104      Supplier<String> initialAccessTokenSupplier;
105      boolean requireSecure = true;
106      Duration httpTimeout = DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT;
107      Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
108
109      /** Constructor. */
110      protected Builder() {}
111
112      /**
113       * Sets the AS {@code registration_endpoint} URL.  Required.
114       *
115       * @param value The registration endpoint (typically from validated AS metadata's {@code registration_endpoint}).
116       * @return This object.
117       */
118      public Builder registrationEndpoint(URI value) {
119         registrationEndpoint = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
120         return this;
121      }
122
123      /**
124       * Sets the AS {@code issuer} these credentials are being registered with.  Required.
125       *
126       * <p>
127       * Stamped onto the resulting {@link McpClientRegistration} as the SEP-2352 credential-binding key.
128       *
129       * @param value The issuer URI.
130       * @return This object.
131       */
132      public Builder issuer(URI value) {
133         issuer = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
134         return this;
135      }
136
137      /**
138       * Sets the {@code application_type} (SEP-837 <b>MUST</b>).  Required.
139       *
140       * @param value The application type.
141       * @return This object.
142       */
143      public Builder applicationType(McpApplicationType value) {
144         applicationType = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
145         return this;
146      }
147
148      /**
149       * Adds one or more redirect URIs to register (accumulates across calls).  At least one is required.
150       *
151       * @param values The redirect URIs (e.g. from {@link LoopbackRedirectUris#forPort(int, String)}).
152       * @return This object.
153       */
154      public Builder addRedirectUri(URI... values) {
155         assertArgNotNull(ARG_values, values);
156         for (var v : values)
157            redirectUris.add(assertArgNotNull("redirectUri", v));
158         return this;
159      }
160
161      /**
162       * Adds a list of redirect URIs to register (accumulates across calls).  At least one is required.
163       *
164       * @param values The redirect URIs (e.g. from {@link LoopbackRedirectUris#forPort(int, String)}).
165       * @return This object.
166       */
167      public Builder addRedirectUris(List<URI> values) {
168         assertArgNotNull(ARG_values, values);
169         for (var v : values)
170            redirectUris.add(assertArgNotNull("redirectUri", v));
171         return this;
172      }
173
174      /**
175       * Adds requested scopes.
176       *
177       * @param values The scopes.
178       * @return This object.
179       */
180      public Builder scope(String... values) {
181         assertArgNotNull(ARG_values, values);
182         for (var v : values) {
183            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("scope", v);
184            scopes.add(v);
185         }
186         return this;
187      }

189      /**
190       * Adds requested {@code grant_types} (accumulates across calls).  When none are added, defaults to
191       * {@code authorization_code} + {@code refresh_token}.
192       *
193       * @param values The grant type identifiers.
194       * @return This object.
195       */
196      public Builder addGrantType(String... values) {
197         assertArgNotNull(ARG_values, values);
198         for (var v : values) {
199            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("grantType", v);
200            grantTypes.add(v);

202         return this;

204
205      /**
206       * Adds requested {@code response_types} (accumulates across calls).  When none are added, defaults to
207       * {@code code}.
208       *
209       * @param values The response type identifiers.
210       * @return This object.
211       */
212      public Builder addResponseType(String... values) {
213         assertArgNotNull(ARG_values, values);
214         for (var v : values) {
215            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("responseType", v);
216            responseTypes.add(v);
217         }
218         return this;

221      /**
222       * Registers a confidential client ({@code token_endpoint_auth_method=client_secret_basic}) instead of the
223       * default public/native client ({@code token_endpoint_auth_method=none}).
224       *
225       * @param value <jk>true</jk> to register a confidential client.
226       * @return This object.
227       */
228      public Builder confidential(boolean value) {
229         confidential = value;
230         return this;
231      }
232
233      /**
234       * Sets the human-readable {@code client_name}.
235       *
236       * @param value The client name.
237       * @return This object.
238       */
239      public Builder clientName(String value) {
240         clientName = assertArgNotNullOrBlank(ARG_value, value);
241         return this;
242      }
243
244      /**
245       * Sets the RFC 7591 &sect;3 initial access token used to authorize the call to a protected registration
246       * endpoint.
247       *
248       * @param value The initial access token.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
249       * @return This object.
250       */
251      public Builder initialAccessToken(String value) {
252         assertArgNotNullOrBlank(ARG_value, value);
253         initialAccessTokenSupplier = () -> value;
254         return this;
255      }
256
257      /**
258       * Whether to require the registration endpoint to use {@code https} (loopback exempt).  Default <jk>true</jk>.
259       *
260       * @param value <jk>false</jk> to allow a plaintext registration endpoint (testing only).
261       * @return This object.
262       */
263      public Builder requireSecure(boolean value) {
264         requireSecure = value;
265         return this;
266      }
267
268      /**
269       * Sets the connect/read timeout applied to the registration request.  Default 10 seconds.
270       *
271       * @param value The timeout.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be positive.
272       * @return This object.
273       */
274      public Builder httpTimeout(Duration value) {
275         assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
276         assertArg(!value.isZero() && !value.isNegative(), "httpTimeout must be positive (was %s)", value);
277         httpTimeout = value;
278         return this;
279      }
280
281      /**
282       * Sets a callback that customizes the Nimbus {@link HTTPRequest} for the registration call.
283       *
284       * @param value The callback.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
285       * @return This object.
286       */
287      public Builder httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer<HTTPRequest> value) {
288         httpRequestConfigurator = assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
289         return this;
290      }
291
292      /**
293       * Builds the registrar.
294       *
295       * @return A new {@link McpDynamicClientRegistrar}.
296       */
297      public McpDynamicClientRegistrar build() {
298         if (registrationEndpoint == null)
299            throw isex("McpDynamicClientRegistrar requires registrationEndpoint(...)");
300         if (issuer == null)
301            throw isex("McpDynamicClientRegistrar requires issuer(...)");
302         if (applicationType == null)
303            throw isex("McpDynamicClientRegistrar requires applicationType(...) (SEP-837)");
304         if (redirectUris.isEmpty())
305            throw isex("McpDynamicClientRegistrar requires at least one redirectUri(...)");
306         if (requireSecure && ! isSecureOrLoopback(registrationEndpoint))
307            throw isex("McpDynamicClientRegistrar registration endpoint must use https (loopback exempt): " + registrationEndpoint);
308         return new McpDynamicClientRegistrar(this);
309      }
310   }
311
312   /** Default connect/read timeout applied to the registration request when the caller sets none. */
313   static final Duration DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(10);
314
315   private final URI registrationEndpoint;
316   private final URI issuer;
317   private final McpApplicationType applicationType;
318   private final List<URI> redirectUris;
319   private final Set<String> scopes;
320   private final Set<String> grantTypes;
321   private final Set<String> responseTypes;
322   private final boolean confidential;
323   private final String clientName;
324   private final Supplier<String> initialAccessTokenSupplier;
325   private final Duration httpTimeout;
326   private final Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
327
328   /**
329    * Constructor.
330    *
331    * @param b The builder.
332    */
333   protected McpDynamicClientRegistrar(Builder b) {
334      this.registrationEndpoint = b.registrationEndpoint;
335      this.issuer = b.issuer;
336      this.applicationType = b.applicationType;
337      this.redirectUris = u(cp(b.redirectUris));
338      this.scopes = u(new LinkedHashSet<>(b.scopes));
339      this.grantTypes = u(b.grantTypes.isEmpty() ? new LinkedHashSet<>(List.of("authorization_code", "refresh_token")) : new LinkedHashSet<>(b.grantTypes));
340      this.responseTypes = u(b.responseTypes.isEmpty() ? new LinkedHashSet<>(List.of("code")) : new LinkedHashSet<>(b.responseTypes));
341      this.confidential = b.confidential;
342      this.clientName = b.clientName;
343      this.initialAccessTokenSupplier = b.initialAccessTokenSupplier;
344      this.httpTimeout = b.httpTimeout;
345      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
346   }
347
348   /**
349    * Builds the Nimbus {@link OIDCClientRegistrationRequest} that {@link #register()} would send, declaring the
350    * {@code application_type}, redirect URIs, grant/response types, {@code token_endpoint_auth_method}, scope, and
351    * (if configured) the initial access token.
352    *
353    * <p>
354    * Package-private: returns a Nimbus {@code provided}-scope type, so it is an internal seam for the module's tests to
355    * inspect the exact request without a network round-trip &mdash; not part of the public API.
356    *
357    * @return The registration request.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
358    */
359   OIDCClientRegistrationRequest buildRegistrationRequest() {
360      var md = new OIDCClientMetadata();
361      md.setApplicationType(applicationType.toNimbus());
362      md.setRedirectionURIs(new LinkedHashSet<>(redirectUris));
363      md.setGrantTypes(mapGrantTypes(grantTypes));
364      md.setResponseTypes(mapResponseTypes(responseTypes));
365      md.setTokenEndpointAuthMethod(confidential ? ClientAuthenticationMethod.CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC : ClientAuthenticationMethod.NONE);
366      if (! scopes.isEmpty())
367         md.setScope(Scope.parse(scopes));
368      if (clientName != null)
369         md.setName(clientName);
370      var iat = initialAccessTokenSupplier == null ? null : new BearerAccessToken(initialAccessTokenSupplier.get());
371      return new OIDCClientRegistrationRequest(registrationEndpoint, md, iat);
372   }
373
374   /**
375    * Parses a (possibly canned) registration {@link HTTPResponse} into an {@link McpClientRegistration}, stamping the
376    * configured {@code issuer}.
377    *
378    * <p>
379    * On a registration error the AS error object's code is surfaced as an {@link McpAuthException} (SEP-837
380    * registration-failure handling).
381    *
382    * <p>
383    * Package-private: accepts a Nimbus {@code provided}-scope type, so it is an internal seam for the module's tests to
384    * map a canned response &mdash; not part of the public API.
385    *
386    * @param httpResponse The registration response.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
387    * @return The mapped registration result.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
388    * @throws McpAuthException If the AS returned an error or the response could not be parsed.
389    */
390   McpClientRegistration parseRegistrationResponse(HTTPResponse httpResponse) {
391      assertArgNotNull("httpResponse", httpResponse);
392      ClientRegistrationResponse resp;
393      try {
394         resp = OIDCClientRegistrationResponseParser.parse(httpResponse);
395      } catch (ParseException e) {
396         throw new McpAuthException("Dynamic client registration response could not be parsed", e);
397      }
398      if (! resp.indicatesSuccess()) {
399         var err = resp.toErrorResponse().getErrorObject();
400         var code = (err == null || err.getCode() == null) ? "unknown_error" : err.getCode();  // HTT: Nimbus's ErrorResponse#getErrorObject() never returns null (verified: even a bodiless/non-JSON error response yields a non-null ErrorObject with a null code), so the err==null branch is unreachable
401         String desc = err == null ? null : err.getDescription();  // HTT: same as above -- err is never null here
402         throw new McpAuthException("Dynamic client registration failed: " + code + (desc == null ? "" : " (" + desc + ")"));
403      }
404      return toRegistration(resp.toSuccessResponse().getClientInformation());
405   }
406
407   /**
408    * Performs the live RFC 7591 registration round-trip: builds the request, applies the finite HTTP timeout and the
409    * caller's {@code httpRequestConfigurator}, sends it, and maps the response.
410    *
411    * @return The issued registration.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
412    * @throws McpAuthException If the HTTP call fails or the AS returned an error.
413    */
414   public McpClientRegistration register() {
415      var http = buildRegistrationRequest().toHTTPRequest();
416      var ms = (int) Math.min(httpTimeout.toMillis(), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
417      http.setConnectTimeout(ms);
418      http.setReadTimeout(ms);
419      if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
420         httpRequestConfigurator.accept(http);
421      HTTPResponse httpResp;
422      try {
423         httpResp = http.send();
424      } catch (IOException e) {
425         throw new McpAuthException("Dynamic client registration HTTP call failed", e);
426      }
427      return parseRegistrationResponse(httpResp);
428   }
429
430   private McpClientRegistration toRegistration(ClientInformation info) {
431      var secret = info.getSecret();
432      Optional<String> clientSecret = (secret == null || secret.getValue() == null) ? oe() : o(secret.getValue());  // HTT: Nimbus's ClientCredentialsParser rejects a blank/empty client_secret while parsing (throws ParseException before a Secret with a null value could ever be constructed), so secret!=null implies secret.getValue()!=null -- verified against oauth2-oidc-sdk 11.38.2
433      Optional<Instant> secretExpires = (secret == null || secret.getExpirationDate() == null) ? oe() : o(secret.getExpirationDate().toInstant());
434      var rat = info.getRegistrationAccessToken();
435      Optional<String> regAccessToken = (rat == null || rat.getValue() == null) ? oe() : o(rat.getValue());  // HTT: same guarantee as client_secret above -- Nimbus rejects a blank registration_access_token during parsing, so rat!=null implies rat.getValue()!=null
436      Optional<URI> regClientUri = info.getRegistrationURI() == null ? oe() : o(info.getRegistrationURI());
437      return new McpClientRegistration(
438         info.getID().getValue(),
439         clientSecret,
440         secretExpires,
441         regAccessToken,
442         regClientUri,
443         issuer,
444         redirectUris,
445         applicationType,
446         extrasFrom(info));
447   }
448
449   /** Surfaces any non-registered custom fields the AS returned in the registration response as the registration's extras. */
450   private static Map<String,Object> extrasFrom(ClientInformation info) {
451      var md = info.getMetadata();
452      var custom = md == null ? null : md.getCustomFields();  // HTT: ClientInformation's constructor does Objects.requireNonNull(metadata), so a successfully-parsed ClientInformation's getMetadata() can never return null
453      return (custom == null || custom.isEmpty()) ? Map.of() : new LinkedHashMap<>(custom);  // HTT: ClientMetadata#getCustomFields() is documented to return an empty JSONObject, never null, so custom==null is unreachable here too
454   }
455
456   private static Set<GrantType> mapGrantTypes(Set<String> v) {
457      var out = new LinkedHashSet<GrantType>();
458      for (var g : v) {
459         try {
460            out.add(GrantType.parse(g));
461         } catch (ParseException e) {  // HTT: catch-block entry is unreachable for the same reason as the throw below -- GrantType.parse never throws for a value that has already passed assertArgNotNullOrBlank
462            throw iaex(e, "Invalid grant_type '%s'", g);  // HTT: GrantType.parse only throws ParseException for a null/blank value, already rejected by addGrantType's assertArgNotNullOrBlank guard
463         }
464      }
465      return out;
466   }
467
468   private static Set<ResponseType> mapResponseTypes(Set<String> v) {
469      var out = new LinkedHashSet<ResponseType>();
470      for (var r : v) {
471         try {
472            out.add(ResponseType.parse(r));
473         } catch (ParseException e) {  // HTT: catch-block entry is unreachable for the same reason as the throw below -- ResponseType.parse never throws for a value that has already passed assertArgNotNullOrBlank
474            throw iaex(e, "Invalid response_type '%s'", r);  // HTT: ResponseType.parse only throws ParseException for a null/blank value, already rejected by addResponseType's assertArgNotNullOrBlank guard
475         }
476      }
477      return out;
478   }
479
480   /** Whether the URI is {@code https} or targets a loopback host (exempt from the https requirement). */
481   static boolean isSecureOrLoopback(URI uri) {
482      return UriUtils.isSecureOrLoopback(uri);
483   }
484
485   @Override /* Object */
486   public String toString() {
487      return "McpDynamicClientRegistrar[registrationEndpoint=" + registrationEndpoint
488         + ", issuer=" + issuer
489         + ", applicationType=" + applicationType
490         + ", redirectUris=" + redirectUris
491         + ", confidential=" + confidential
492         + ", initialAccessToken=" + (initialAccessTokenSupplier != null ? "<redacted>" : "<none>")
493         + "]";
494   }
